title: Praklion of the Cauldron
summary: Praklion retreats twice before the quest fight can be completed.
overview: Praklion retreats twice before the quest fight can be completed.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: At 70% and 30%, Praklion wipes threat and moves to a new location.
Follow the retreat and wait for the brief immunity to end before rebuilding threat.
Allow both retreats to happen; the second stage enables the quest-specific drop.
